title: Sharp binary-channel information contraction on the cube
exact_target: Let X be uniform on ${-1,1}^n$, $u:{-1,1}^n\to [-1,1]$, and $Y\in {-1,1}$ have conditional mean u(X). If $T_\rho $ independently flips cube coordinates with correlation $\rho $, must $I(T_\rho u)\leq \psi (|\rho |\psi ^{-1}(I(u)))$ for all $-1\leq \rho \leq 1$, where $I(u)=h(Eu)-E$ h(u), h(a) is the binary entropy of (1+a)/2, and $\psi (a)=\log $ $2-h(a)$?
